description: A red bedspread fills the view with a white pillow at the top, and a couple of small coins lie on the bed. The right hand holds a coin-like fidget-spinner ring near the center while the left hand moves in from the left toward it; the right hand flips the right-hand object with a quick thumb motion, and the left hand briefly comes close as if to steady or catch it before both hands separate and the right hand brings the object back up.
